b1-matyas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Election of 1458
b1-matyas-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the election of King Matthias in 1458.
b1-matyas-01.prompt: Say in which year Matthias was elected king, where the people gathered and how old he was.
cues: Say the year of the election
b1-matyas-01.target: Mátyást 1458-ban választották királlyá. A nép a Duna jegén gyűlt össze, és Mátyás akkor alig tizenöt éves volt.
b1-matyas-01.english: Matthias was elected king in 1458. The people gathered on the ice of the Danube, and Matthias was barely fifteen then.
b1-matyas-01.canDo: I can narrate the dramatic January 1458 election of young Matthias on the frozen Danube.

b1-matyas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Black Army
b1-matyas-02.scenario: On a museum visit in Buda, the guide asks you what the Black Army was and why it won so often.
b1-matyas-02.prompt: Say what kind of army the Black Army was and how its discipline helped it.
cues: Say what kind of army it was
Link its discipline to its victories
b1-matyas-02.target: A fekete sereg állandó zsoldoshadsereg volt. Minél fegyelmezettebb volt, annál több győzelmet aratott.
b1-matyas-02.english: The Black Army was a standing mercenary army. The more disciplined it was, the more victories it achieved.
b1-matyas-02.canDo: I can describe the composition, discipline, and weaponry of Matthias's Black Army (fekete sereg).

b1-matyas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Renaissance Court
b1-matyas-03.scenario: At a museum in Visegrád, a visitor asks you why the Hungarian Renaissance is famous.
b1-matyas-03.prompt: Say what people often say about the Renaissance in Hungary and name the two centres.
cues: Say what people often say about Hungary and Italy
b1-matyas-03.target: Úgy mondják, hogy Olaszországon kívül itt virágzott először a reneszánsz. Buda és Visegrád volt a két központ.
b1-matyas-03.english: People say that outside Italy the Renaissance flourished here first. Buda and Visegrád were the two centres.
b1-matyas-03.canDo: I can say that Hungary is often called the first country outside Italy to adopt Renaissance art.

b1-matyas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Matthias the Just
b1-matyas-04.scenario: In your Hungarian class, the teacher asks why people call King Matthias 'the Just'.
b1-matyas-04.prompt: Explain what the folktales tell about the king and why he is called the Just.
cues: Say what the folktales tell about his disguise
Say what he did to the haughty lords
Say what people call him because of this
b1-matyas-04.target: A mesék szerint Mátyás álruhában járta az országot. Keményen megleckéztette a gőgös urakat. Ezért ő az igazságos király.
b1-matyas-04.english: According to the tales, Matthias travelled the country in disguise. He taught the haughty lords a hard lesson. That is why he is the just king.
b1-matyas-04.canDo: I can explain why King Matthias earned the popular title 'Matthias the Just' (Mátyás, az igazságos).

b1-matyas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Death of Matthias
b1-matyas-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how King Matthias died.
b1-matyas-05.prompt: Say when and where King Matthias died and where he was buried.
cues: Say the year and the city of his death
b1-matyas-05.target: Mátyás király 1490-ben halt meg Bécsben. Székesfehérváron temették el.
b1-matyas-05.english: King Matthias died in Vienna in 1490. He was buried in Székesfehérvár.
b1-matyas-05.canDo: I can say when and where King Matthias died and where he was buried.

b1-matyas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Reign of Matthias
b1-matyas-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to tell the story of King Matthias in a few sentences.
b1-matyas-consolidation.prompt: Tell Matthias's story briefly, from his election to his death.
cues: Mention his army and his court
Say when and where he died
b1-matyas-consolidation.target: Mátyást 1458-ban választották királlyá. Állandó hadsereget tartott fenn, és Budán reneszánsz udvara volt. 1490-ben halt meg Bécsben.
b1-matyas-consolidation.english: Matthias was elected king in 1458. He maintained a standing army, and he had a Renaissance court in Buda. He died in Vienna in 1490.
b1-matyas-consolidation.canDo: I can narrate the entire historical reign of King Matthias Corvinus from 1458 to 1490.
